polygon.name: La Rioja, Spain
polygon.description: Closed boundary ring of La Rioja (NUTS-2 ES23) as [latitude, longitude] pairs, in the vertex order Polytope's feature: {type: polygon} expects.

source.dataset: Eurostat GISCO NUTS 2021, level 2, 1:1 million, EPSG:4326
source.licence: Eurostat NUTS — free reuse with attribution (© EuroGeographics for the administrative boundaries)

polygon.processing: Largest polygon (1 part(s)); Douglas-Peucker simplification with epsilon = 0.005 degrees -> 202 vertices; longitude/latitude swapped to latitude/longitude; ring closed.

climatedt.attribution: This data is created based on data of the European Union, using the Destination Earth Platform, but has been modified by Anne Fouilloux.
